name: coldlytics
description: Search a database of small and mid-sized businesses, mainly in the US, Canada, UK and Australia, by industry, location, size, revenue or website technology. Find the owners, directors and managers at those companies, look up a company by its website, and reveal a contact's work email and direct phone number. If a company isn't in the database yet, you can request research and get its decision-makers back within one to three business days. Any action that uses Coldlytics credits asks for your confirmation first. A Coldlytics account is required.

interface.longDescription: Search a database of small and mid-sized businesses, mainly in the US, Canada, UK and Australia, by industry, location, size, revenue or website technology. Find the owners, directors and managers at those companies, look up a company by its website, and reveal a contact's work email and direct phone number. If a company isn't in the database yet, you can request research and get its decision-makers back within one to three business days. Any action that uses Coldlytics credits asks for your confirmation first. A Coldlytics account is required.
capabilities: Search companies by industry, location, size, revenue or website technology
Find owners, directors and managers at a company
Look up a company by its website
Reveal a contact's work email and direct phone number
Request research on companies not yet in the database
defaultPrompt: Find HVAC companies in Phoenix with 10 to 50 employees and tell me who runs them.
Look up the company behind this website and find its owner's work email.
Build a list of dental practices in Austin, Texas and reveal the owners' contact details.

publication.release_notes: Initial directory release. Search Coldlytics' database of small and mid-sized companies and the people who run them, look up a company by website, reveal work emails and direct dials, and request research on companies not yet in the database.

positive.prompt: Use Coldlytics to find plumbing companies in Austin, TX with at least 5 employees
positive.expected_behavior: A list of plumbing companies located in Austin, TX, each with company name, website domain, address/city, employee count and category. No credits are spent. If there are more results, the response says so (has_more) and the assistant can page further.

positive.prompt: Use Coldlytics to find the owners of plumbing companies in Austin, TX
positive.expected_behavior: A list of people (owners and founders) at Austin plumbing companies, with name, job title, company and flags showing whether a work email and direct dial are available. Emails and phone numbers are not shown yet and no credits are spent.

positive.prompt: Use Coldlytics to reveal the email and direct dial for the first person in those results
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant asks for confirmation because credits will be used, then returns the person's work email and direct dial (when available) plus credits_charged (1 per email, 1 per dial). The contact is saved to the account's Contacts. Revealing a contact the account already owns returns the data again at no charge (already_owned: true).

positive.prompt: Show me the contacts I've saved in Coldlytics
positive.expected_behavior: The account's saved contacts (29 Austin plumbing company owners), each with name, title, company, email and direct dial. Read-only, no credits spent.

positive.prompt: Show me my Coldlytics research tasks and the contacts from the Austin plumbers task
positive.expected_behavior: A list containing the delivered research task "Austin plumbers", then its details: status delivered and the 20 researched contacts with names, titles, companies and emails. Read-only, no credits spent.

negative.description: Writing sales copy, not finding contacts
negative.prompt: Write a friendly cold email I can send to plumbing company owners

negative.description: Sending emails or running outreach campaigns
negative.prompt: Send a follow-up email to all of my leads

negative.description: Stock prices and financial news about public companies
negative.prompt: What is Home Depot's stock price and latest quarterly revenue?

review.commerce_description: Coldlytics does not sell products or process payments inside ChatGPT. Contact data is paid for with credits on the user's existing Coldlytics account.
